summary: Operator pages confirm season May 1 - Oct 31, 47 FHU + 5 W/E + 3 tent sites with 20/30/50 A at every RV site, Wi-Fi, laundry, ResNexus/phone booking, family-of-5 rates with a 7th night free. ResNexus now shows a captcha, so fees ($45 W/E - $50 FHU) are cited from the 2026-10-15 engine read. Note trimmed of hookup, price, booking and RV Life text.
flags: Seasonal share: the rates page offers 'Monthly Sites - call for rates' and 'Seasonal Sites - call for rates' without saying how many; nightly sites are sold online (the engine listed 25 RV/tent sites with nightly rates on 2026-10-15), so long-stay tests 2 and 4 pass on the evidence seen.
Price gate: base $45 (water/electric), full-service $50, at the US$50 line; no gateway within 40 km (Mackinaw City 185 km); the family has not stayed here.
